BETA Close X Barratt Redrow plc has purchased 1,653,000 ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £386 million share repurchase program announced on July 15, 2026. The purchases occurred between July 15 and July 17, 2026, with prices ranging from 283.0000 pence to 298.0000 pence per share. Following these transactions, Barratt Redrow holds no shares in treasury, and its total issued ordinary shares stand at 1,408,867,253, with the same number of voting rights. Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 20 July 2026 20 July 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 15 July 2026 to 17 July 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays") as part of its £386 million share repurchase programme announced on 15 July 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,408,867,253 ordinary shares in issue. The total number of voting rights in the Company is therefore 1,408,867,253.
